description: miro-next first fixes for new app

userStories.title: add candiate menu for each candidate on a project.
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be able to see a menu for each candidate on a project so I can view the candidate's details and edit and deleet them  this would work like in the old parent project on https://miro-assessment.com/mirotest/showProject.html?id=2772
acceptanceCriteria: add a menu for each candidate on a project
add a link to view the candidate's details
add a link to edit the candidate's details
add a link to delete the candidate
run prettier to format the code
run the tests to make sure the new code works
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-02-12. Added per-candidate actions menu on project page (view details, edit candidate, delete candidate), implemented candidate detail/edit/delete pages, and added project-scoped candidate API route with GET/PATCH/DELETE ownership checks and validation.

userStories.title: Create a team report page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be able to create a team report page so I can view the team report for a slection of projects.  This would work like in the old parent project on https://miro-assessment.com/mirotest/miroTeamReport.html
acceptanceCriteria: add a form to select the projects to include in the team report
add a button to create the team report
add a button to download the team report
add a button to delete the team report
run prettier to format the code
run the tests to make sure the new code works
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-02-12. Implemented /team-reports with project selection, create/download/delete report actions, added POST /api/team-reports with auth + ownership checks, and generated report rows with candidate counts plus CSV export.
